findings.current: Merely being acquainted with Jongni Chu could be enough to get Cheongpung beaten half to death.
findings.defect: The draft makes the punishment explicitly near-fatal, while the source uses a colorful but less specific expression for undergoing a severe beating or punishment.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the threat of physical punishment without adding the unsupported degree implied by “half to death.”
findings.replacement: Merely being acquainted with Jongni Chu could be enough to earn Cheongpung a sound thrashing.
findings.source: 종리추와 친분이 있다는 사실 하나만으로도 치도곤을 치를 수도 있다.

findings.current: On a peaceful Baekjung afternoon,[^1] hundreds of masked men had appeared out of nowhere and continued their slaughter with emotionless eyes.
findings.defect: The source places the attack in broad daylight or the middle of the day, not specifically in the afternoon.
findings.rationale: 대낮 denotes full or broad daylight; “afternoon” narrows and shifts the stated time.
findings.replacement: On that peaceful Baekjung Day,[^1] in broad daylight, hundreds of masked men appeared out of nowhere and continued their slaughter with emotionless eyes.
findings.source: 평화롭던 백중 대낮, 홀연히 나타난 수백의 복면인들은 무감각한 눈빛으로 살행을 이어 갔다.

findings.current: More than a dozen masters were crushed by a single attack.
findings.defect: The draft changes the quantity from ten-odd masters to more than twelve.
findings.rationale: 십수 명 means ten-some or more than ten people and can include eleven or twelve, which “more than a dozen” excludes.
findings.replacement: More than ten masters were crushed by a single attack.
findings.source: 단 일수에 십수 명의 고수가 바스러지는 압도적인 광경.

findings.current: “What does that matter? All you need to know is that we’re the ones who will grab your shiny pate and yank it clean off.”
findings.defect: The draft changes Flame Tiger’s singular, self-aggrandizing claim into a plural claim on behalf of both men.
findings.rationale: 분 refers to the singular person speaking; Han Su’s immediately following question about whether Flame Tiger will handle Hongcheon confirms that Flame Tiger is claiming the task for himself.
findings.replacement: “What does that matter? All you need to know is that I’m the one who’ll grab your shiny pate and rip it off.”
findings.source: “그게 무슨 상관이냐? 네 번들거리는 대가리를 잡고 뽑아 줄 분이라는 것만 알면 되는 것을.”

findings.current: “Ah, now that I think of it, I’d briefly forgotten you were here. Please accept my condolences.”
findings.defect: The draft invents “you were here” as the object of what Han Su forgot, turning the line into an unsupported personal slight.
findings.rationale: The Korean deliberately leaves the forgotten matter unstated before Han Su offers his condolences.
findings.replacement: “Ah, come to think of it, I’d forgotten for a moment. Please accept my condolences.”
findings.source: “아, 그러고 보니 잠시 잊고 있었군. 심심한 유감의 뜻을 표하네.”

findings.current: “On our way here, we heard that someone had died. Dharma King Hong Dao—the very Senior Brother you mentioned.”
findings.defect: The draft says Hongcheon mentioned his Senior Brother, but he has not done so in the dialogue.
findings.rationale: 바로 자네 사형 identifies Hong Dao as Hongcheon’s Senior Brother; it does not refer back to a prior mention.
findings.replacement: “On our way here, we heard that someone had died. Dharma King Hong Dao—your Senior Brother.”
findings.source: “올라오는 길에 한 사람이 죽었다는 소식을 들었지 뭔가. 법왕 굉도, 바로 자네 사형 말일세.”

findings.current: As if they had sensed their leaders’ aura, the masked men took a step forward with emotionless eyes.
findings.defect: The draft changes the singular “leader” into multiple leaders.
findings.rationale: 우두머리 is singular, so the masked men are responding to one leader’s aura rather than both old men collectively.
findings.replacement: As if they had sensed their leader’s aura, the masked men took a step forward with emotionless eyes.
findings.source: 우두머리의 기세를 느낀 듯, 복면인들이 무감각한 눈빛으로 한 걸음을 내디뎠다.

findings.current: The Yin-Yang Twin Freaks moved their hands with dark smiles.
findings.defect: The generic “moved their hands” loses the specific flicking gesture that immediately precedes the renewed attack.
findings.rationale: 손을 떨쳤다 describes a sharp flick of the hands, a concrete command-like action rather than unspecified movement.
findings.replacement: The Yin-Yang Twin Freaks flicked their hands, dark smiles on their faces.
findings.source: 음양쌍괴가 짙은 미소와 함께 손을 떨쳤다.

summary: Several actionable fidelity errors alter subjects, quantities, actions, and deliberately omitted information; additional localized issues over-specify punishment and time of day.
